title: Stage a shared result as an event
summary: Build waiting, interruption, reveal, and selected states for a public drawing without turning it into a dashboard.
originNote: Distilled from a recurring history-derived interest in staging chance, waiting, and consequence as a coherent ritual.

setup.instructions: Mount the fictional event packet. Build a self-contained runnable artifact with no network calls or external media.

turns.content: Read fixtures/event.json and build a complete responsive result surface as index.html. It must let a reviewer enter waiting, connection-interrupted, sealed, reveal, and selected states without reloading. Treat the drawing as a room of people awaiting one consequential moment, not as a metrics dashboard. Derive a visual register from the event instead of using supplied style adjectives. Motion, copy, type, and sound-free feedback may be expressive when they clarify state. Each state container must expose its key as data-state, and every state must remain distinct under prefers-reduced-motion. Do not invent money, gambling, accounts, or prizes beyond the packet.

Revise the same artifact so that any flourish which does not clarify anticipation, interruption, verification, reveal, or consequence is removed or reassigned. Preserve the eventful register; do not flatten the result into a conventional card dashboard.

checks.description: All five scripted event states have inspectable hooks.
Activate every state with and without reduced motion and verify that consequence remains perceptible.
